boundary: in-process shared service: per-request permission-profile resolution, authorization, execution and compact JSON serialization; excludes HTTP transport
build: cargo +1.88.0 test --release -p vulcan-app shared_query_stage_benchmark -- --ignored (VULCAN_MDB_PROFILE_SESSION=1, VULCAN_MDB_PROFILE_SAMPLES=1001, optional VULCAN_MDB_PROFILE_WATCH=1 and VULCAN_MDB_PROFILE_SCOPE=benchmark_public)
requests: nine canonical fixture queries cycled; first request excluded; each request independently checked for exact totals, ordered paths, body omission, diagnostics and the 256 KiB bound
host_conditions: shared development host with browser and agent sessions; load average 4.1-5.7 during these runs; not the designated reference machine

freshness.watched: a scope's walk proof is reused while the change monitor is healthy with no notification since before that walk, the cooperating write epoch is unchanged, and the proof is under 30 s old; controls are verified every request
freshness.strict: every request verifies controls and walks every visible record

limitations: single client; no concurrent readers or writers
HTTP transport and daemon scheduling excluded
watched freshness observes external edits only after notification delivery
